subject: Hosting/on-prem onramp: access, topology, and acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@helixsystems.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding kickoff: access details & topology for Helix private deploy

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking Helix through the Private deployment path. We're ready to start the network handoff and want to make sure the access and topology bits are nailed before the initial smoke window. Quick summary of what we can share today: 

- Attached: high-level topology diagram (helix-topology-20260623.png) and our internal firewall policy snapshot.
- Outbound egress: NAT through 54.241.33.12/32 and proxy 10.8.0.21 (note port 443 only).
- Management jump host: bastion.helix.internal:22 (will be reachable from your bastion IP allowlist).
- KMS: we manage keys via AWS KMS; we will provide ARNs once account-level trust is confirmed.

Asks for Redwood:
1) Can you confirm the minimum ingress ports required from our infra? We want to pre-provision security-team changes.
2) Can you provide the runbook/checklist you use for Day-0 activation so our network/security teams can align?
3) Do you have an expected window (2–4 hours) for the initial smoke flip? Prefer afternoons PST next week.

Sharing Lina on this thread — she owns the topology and will attach a cleaned SVG if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Head of DevOps, Helix Systems
Attachments: helix-topology-20260623.png (image/png)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@helixsystems.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff: access details & topology for Helix private deploy

Samir — thanks for the diagram and the quick summary. Attaching our Day-0 checklist (redwood-onprem-checklist-v1.xlsx) — it's a compact checklist we run through with customers during the first activation. High-level notes from our side: 

- Ingress requirements: 443 (control plane and API), 9222 (metrics/diagnostics over TLS when enabled), and 22 only for bastion-managed SSH (we recommend using temporary gateway credentials).
- Outbound: allow 443 to Redwood control plane endpoints (listed in the checklist) and to your KMS ARNs once provided.
- IP allowlist: please add the temporary engineer IP we will share on D-1 and the dedicated egress IPs included in the checklist.
- MTU: aim for 1500 across the path; if you have jumbo frames in the colo, call that out so we can match.

Action items for Helix:
- Lina: can you drop a sanitized SVG/PDF of the topology into the Drive link and confirm bastion source IP range?
- Samir: review the checklist and confirm you can schedule a 3-hour window next Tue/Wed afternoon PST (we prefer Tue 13:00–16:00).

I'll also loop Ben for the acceptance criteria portion — Ben, see the last tab in the attachment (Acceptance & rollback criteria).

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-onprem-checklist-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Lina Park <lina@helixsystems.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Khan <samir@helixsystems.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff: access details & topology for Helix private deploy

Jonas, Samir — uploaded the sanitized topology (also attaching helix-topology-20260623.png here). Couple of clarifications inline: 

- Bastion source IPs: 3 ranges — 203.0.113.64/28, 203.0.113.96/28, 198.51.100.0/27 (we'll use the first by default).
- KMS: ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:987654321:key/abcd-ef01; we will create a cross-account grant for the CustomerManagedKey role.
- Firewall rules: internal management plane uses 10.220.0.0/22; customer-facing egress flows exit through NAT pool 54.241.33.12/32.

We can confirm Tue 2026-06-30 13:00–16:00 PST for the smoke. Lina (CC) will be on standby during the window. Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aXb-Helix-Onprem (topology + rule export).

Thanks,
Lina Park
Infra Architect, Helix Systems
Attachments: helix-topology-20260623.png (image/png)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@helixsystems.io>, Lina Park <lina@helixsystems.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding kickoff: access details & topology for Helix private deploy — acceptance criteria & next steps

Thanks, team — good alignment. Summary and Day-0 acceptance checklist (short):

1) Network routing and IP allowlist
   - Helix confirms bastion source IP block (we received 203.0.113.64/28).
   - Egress NAT 54.241.33.12/32 allowed to Redwood control plane endpoints in the checklist.

2) Auth & KMS
   - KMS ARN and cross-account grant provisioned (Lina -> confirm when grant is active).

3) Day-0 runbook execution
   - Pre-checks (D-1): connectivity test from bastion -> control plane (port 443), DNS resolution, MTU sanity.
   - Smoke window (D0): 13:00–15:00 PST 2026-06-30 (we'll aim to keep it to 2 hours; have rollback ready).

4) Evidence & signoff
   - Helix to upload final topology and firewall dump to Drive.
   - We'll fill the MOP signoff template (mop-signoff-template.pdf) and circulating a DocuSign link for formal signoff post smoke.

Please reply with any outstanding blockers. If none, Jonas will create the activation ticket and share the temporary engineer IPs on D-1.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Activation Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: mop-signoff-template.pdf
